a: A native story file that imports forge as a namespace is indexed as CSF
Component reach counts a shadowing local or parameter as a use of a same-named component
moduleInfo drops `export enum`, `export * as ns from` and destructured `export const`, which ast.bindingsOf reads
A duplicate story id within one file is reported as two files and told to retitle one
watchRecovery's `read` map keeps an entry for every load whose transform never runs
b: Story ids are built from the raw export name, so they disagree with Storybook's for any camelCase export, and a meta's `id` is ignored
`tags`, `includeStories`/`excludeStories` and `viewport`'s sides are read only when written inline, unlike every other meta field
An SSH host alias of the common `github.com-<account>` form is taken as a GitHub Enterprise host, so the issues panel errors instead of listing
